summary: 79-year-old Evelyn Starner of Cedar Cove was swept away when a wall of water and debris slammed into her Big Thompson Canyon home in the early hours of Saturday; an elderly neighbor tried to pull her from the river but could not; her body was found Saturday 2013-09-21 on the bank of the Big Thompson River
notes: Date approximate: incident in the early hours of 2013-09-14; reported missing and presumed dead 2013-09-15/16 as the unnamed 80-year-old Cedar Grove woman; body recovered 2013-09-21; Larimer County sheriff spokesman John Schulz; 8th confirmed flood fatality; September 2013 Front Range flood
